p: The top end of Swansea's High Street is only a short walk from the railway station, so this Stardust is easy to find if you've just got off the train. It's an older part of the city centre with a few independent shops and creative spaces along it, and Castle Square, with the ruins of Swansea Castle beside it, is down the hill at the other end.

If you're making a day of it, Swansea Market is the place for Welsh cakes and cockles, and the seafront and Swansea Bay are only a short walk south. The Mumbles, with its pier, is a bus ride round the bay.
Stardust is an 18+ venue, so bring ID if you look young.
